---
title: "Exponent after big-O and little-o"
format:
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - ../macros-pdf-header.tex
      - ../macros.qmd
---

An exponent after a big-O or little-o must rise over a tall argument.

```{=latex}
\newsavebox{\withexp}\newsavebox{\withoutexp}
\sbox{\withexp}{$\bigO{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\bigO{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt BIGOEXPRISES\else BIGOEXPSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\littleo{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\littleo{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt LITTLEOEXPRISES\else LITTLEOEXPSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\asymub{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\asymub{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt ASYMUBEXPRISES\else ASYMUBEXPSTUCK\fi
```

The rejected form is the control: an unbraced body must not rise, so the test can fail.

```{=latex}
\newcommand{\unbracedcontrol}[1]{O\paren{#1}}
\sbox{\withexp}{$\unbracedcontrol{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\unbracedcontrol{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt CTRLRISES\else CTRLSTUCK\fi
```
